nodes.label: twingate-desktop-notifier User Service (Sign-in)
nodes.rationale: Twingate's own notifier handles authentication; no URL scraping or credential handling.

nodes.label: GNOME Shell ModalDialog
nodes.rationale: Built-in shell dialog keeps everything inside extension.js.

nodes.label: Tile 'Set up Twingate…' State
nodes.rationale: Closing early never re-pops the dialog by itself; clicking the tile reopens it.

nodes.label: Three-State Detection (no client / not set up / set up)
nodes.norm_label: three-state detection (no client / not set up / set up)

nodes.label: First-Run Setup Dialog
nodes.rationale: Take a stranger from enabled to connected with as little terminal as possible, whether or not Twingate is installed.

nodes.label: Not Doing List (no prefs.js, no login form, no telemetry)
nodes.norm_label: not doing list (no prefs.js, no login form, no telemetry)
nodes.rationale: Avoid root from extension, auto-answering ToS, prefs UI upkeep, credential handling, untestable GNOME 47+ claims, leaking network name.

nodes.label: extensions.gnome.org Review Guidelines
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.rationale: Privileged subprocesses must be avoided; if needed, pkexec on a non-user-modifiable executable. Current sudo+askpass in ~/.cache likely rejected.

nodes.label: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.norm_label: install and set up twingate step
nodes.rationale: User answers Twingate's own questions, including Terms of Service, in the terminal.

nodes.label: Official Twingate Install Script (apt/rpm repo)
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step

nodes.label: Don't Ask Again Polkit Rule
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.rationale: Optional; if skipped, GNOME's polkit dialog (auth_admin_keep) remembers the password a few minutes.

nodes.label: twingate setup (interactive, root)
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.rationale: Feeding answers on stdin is fragile; Terms must be accepted by the user, never answered automatically.

nodes.label: Extension Never Runs Anything as Root
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.norm_label: extension never runs anything as root
nodes.rationale: Keeps the extension inside the extensions.gnome.org rule against privileged subprocesses; user stays in control.

nodes.label: Paste-This Terminal Step (Copy / Open Terminal)
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.rationale: Admin steps shown as a command the user pastes; dialog polls and auto-advances when done.

nodes.label: Start/Stop via systemd D-Bus StartUnit/StopUnit
nodes.community_name: Install and Set Up Twingate Step
nodes.rationale: GNOME shows its own polkit password dialog; removes sudo, zenity and askpass, and fits review rules. Loses twingate start's other-VPN warning.
